# 一 …就 … · *jat1 … zau6 …*

**Meaning:** as soon as …; whenever … · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjat1-zau6-as-soon-as).

一 before the first verb and 就 before the second link two events closely: as soon as one happens, the other follows.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我一到就打電話畀你。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 jat1 dou3 zau6 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5. |
| Yale | ngóh yāt dou jauh dá dihn wá béi néih. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄧㄜㆵ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ³ ㄗㄜㄨ⁶ ㄉㄚ² ㄉㄧㄣ⁶ ㄨㄚ² ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄋㄝㄧ⁵. |
| English | I'll call you as soon as I arrive. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢一放工就返屋企。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 jat1 fong3 gung1 zau6 faan1 uk1 kei2. |
| Yale | kéuih yāt fong gūng jauh fāan ūk kéi. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄧㄜㆵ¹ ㄈㄛㄥ³ ㄍㄨㄥ¹ ㄗㄜㄨ⁶ ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㄨㆶ¹ ㄎㄝㄧ². |
| English | He goes home as soon as he finishes work. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我一飲咖啡就瞓唔着。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 jat1 jam2 gaa3 fe1 zau6 fan3 m4 zoek6. |
| Yale | ngóh yāt yám ga fē jauh fan m̀h jeuhk. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄧㄜㆵ¹ ㄧㄜㆬ² ㄍㄚ³ ㄈㄝ¹ ㄗㄜㄨ⁶ ㄈㄜㄣ³ ㆬ⁴ ㄗㆦㆶ⁶. |
| English | Whenever I drink coffee, I can't sleep. |
